Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

MrWeiCodes/dsh-permgate.body:
# dsh-permgate — DSH Permission Gateway

> A fine-grained permission control plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH)

**🌏 Chinese | [English](https://github.com/MrWeiCodes/dsh-permgate/blob/HEAD/README_EN.md)**

`dsh` · `dsh-plugin` · `plugin` · `permission control` · `approval` · `sandbox` · `security` · `AI agent` · `permission control` · `approval` · `sandbox` · `permission gateway`

## Introduction

Currently, DSH only has three levels of permissions: [Read only], [Workspace Write], [Full access], with relatively coarse granularity. This plugin adds a **"Custom Review"** permission gateway for item-by-item review of tool calls.

Permissions are reviewed item-by-item according to categories (directory access / command execution / file reading / image reading / file editing / undo operations / spawn sub-agents / repeat operations), supporting dual-level global/project configuration, exceptions (whitelist/blacklist), quick tool defaults, custom rules, fallback strategies, and bilingual Chinese/English approval popups and sandbox escalation workflows.

## Features

- **Eight Permission Categories**: Directory access outside workspace, command execution, file reading, image reading, file editing, undo operations, sub-agents, and repeat operations are controlled separately. Each category can independently be set to "Ask / Allow / Deny" — strict on sensitive operations, lenient on routine operations, defining AI's boundaries according to your habits.
- **Global/Project Dual-Level Configuration**: One set of global rules manages all projects, then fine-tune individually per project; projects without their own settings automatically follow the global rules, eliminating duplicate configuration.
- **Exceptions (Whitelist/Blacklist)**: Add paths and commands that "frequently need approval" or "absolutely must not be allowed" to exceptions; once matched, they are directly approved or denied without popup interruptions each time.
- **Quick Tools**: Tools like `web_search`, `skill` that cannot be categorized by file or command can also have their defaults independently set to ask, directly allow, or directly deny.
- **Custom Rules**: Combine rules arbitrarily by tool name, file path, parameter content (e.g., "no tool may execute `rm -rf`"), more flexible than categorical exceptions; priority: rules > exceptions > defaults, controlling the most scenarios with the fewest rules.
- **Approval Popup**: View all information in a single popup—what the AI wants to do, why, and specific parameters; file edits/writes directly display diffs before and after changes (+N/-N lines), undo operations display what this undo will restore, no need to open files for comparison anymore. If you feel a certain type of operation no longer needs to be asked about, you can add it to the project whitelist/blacklist with one click.

gakiyukr/zcode2api-plus.body:
# zcode2api

Z.AI ZCode Coding Plan → OpenAI/Anthropic compatible gateway (**Go version, currently the main line**).

Wraps Z.AI Coding Plan account pools into a standard API: multi-account polling (prioritizing discount quotas), fully automatic CAPTCHA solving, quota and plan expiration monitoring, OAuth login, account-level outbound proxy, automatic event plan claiming, account archiving, single binary delivery (frontend embedded, no external runtime).

> 📦 History: This project was originally implemented in Python and has now been replaced by the Go rewrite as the main line.
> The old Python version is preserved in the [`python-legacy`](https://github.com/gakiyukr/zcode2api-plus/blob/HEAD/../../tree/python-legacy) branch (archive maintenance only, no longer updated).

## Endpoint Overview

| Endpoint | Protocol | Description |
|------|------|------|
| `POST /v1/messages` | Anthropic Messages | Streaming/non-streaming, byte-level pass-through |
| `POST /v1/chat/completions` | OpenAI Chat | Local conversion to Anthropic Messages, including tool calls |
| `POST /v1/responses` | OpenAI Responses | Serves Codex CLI (stateless mode; `previous_response_id` returns 400) |
| `POST /async/v1/messages` | Anthropic Async | ticket + keepalive + stream break semantics |
| `GET /v1/models` | Dual compatibility superset | Anthropic and OpenAI shape fields coexist |
| `/admin/*` | — | Embedded React admin dashboard |
| `/guest` | — | Guest account submission page (requires admin to enable invitation codes) |

Three types of external request formats, internally unified to Anthropic Messages upstream pipeline: account selection cycling, CAPTCHA solving, error classification (401/402/429 code family/3010/F001), account state machine and usage statistics maintained once.

## Quick Start

```bash
# Download ready-made artifacts (Releases page: linux × amd64/arm64)
# Or build from source:
go build -o zcode2api ./cmd/zcode2api
./zcode2api serve            # http://127.0.0.1:3000

# Automatic CAPTCHA solving: automatically downloads patched Chromium (about 200MB, no Python required) on first startup;
# Or you can…
```

nexen33/Fahrmony.body: Simplified Chinese | English | Deutsch | 日本語 # Fahrmony 合拍 > A local interoperability bridge tool built for Android Auto, enabling seamless display and partial control of your frequently-used Chinese streaming audio and instant messaging notifications when driving with Android Auto overseas. ## What is Fahrmony? **Fahrmony** is named after the German word for driving (**Fahren**) and the English word for harmony (**Harmony**), translated to Chinese as **合拍**. Many Chinese expats who drive vehicles supporting Android Auto face a frustrating reality: the car's native app ecosystem barely includes the Chinese software they habitually use. While their phones contain their favorite music apps or podcasts, once in the car they often revert to the most primitive Bluetooth audio: the car's infotainment system and steering wheel cannot skip songs or control playback; when receiving new messages from WeChat, Feishu, and other messaging apps during driving, they are forced to risk taking out their phones to check them. **Fahrmony was created precisely to bridge this gap**. It requires no root access, makes no OS modifications, and purely leverages Android's standard system capabilities as a lightweight in-vehicle middleware. It projects the playback state of installed audio apps from your phone's background to your car's full-screen and split-screen controls, and broadcasts important instant messages in voice reading that complies with driving safety standards, making driving overseas more relaxed. ### What Fahrmony Is NOT To avoid misunderstanding, please note before use: - **It is not a standalone music player**: The app does not include any audio decoder and does not provide online music playback or music library services. - **It does not replace the original apps**: Your phone's music and messaging apps remain unchanged; account login, membership benefits, private libraries, and actual audio streams are still entirely managed by the original apps. - **It does not host, proxy, or cache media files**: There is absolutely no audio downloading or cloud relay within the app. - **It does not require root privileges**: It operates entirely within Android's official open sandbox security boundary. - **It does not crack any third-party proprietary protocols**: It contains no reverse-engineered private interfaces or packet tampering for any commercial software. ## How It Works Fahrmony establishes bidirectional bridge links based on Android's open standard interfaces: 1. **Audio media link**: Through notification listening service and media session management, it captures audio media playing on your phone in real-time and bidirectionally maps its state to the car's media browsing service, enabling direct control via the car's infotainment and steering wheel. 2. **Messaging link**: Using system notification listening capabilities to capture message notifications, intelligently parsing and cleaning them, converting them to the car's native card structure format, and triggering safe voice reading on the car's system. 3.…

# plant-shutter for raspberry pi

A Raspberry Pi camera program that uses native H.264 preview and JPEG photography.

> Finished video on Bilibili
> https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1wZ42127U3/?spm_id_from=333.999.0.0

***

## Features

* **Real-time preview** parameter adjustment
* Support sharing captured images using **WebDAV**
* Uses `Video for Linux 2` (**v4l2**) API
* Preview transmits native H.264 via WebSocket
* **All-In-One**, out of the box

## QuickStart

```sh
chmod +x plant-shutter
./plant-shutter
```

Open the [admin interface](https://github.com/plant-shutter/plant-shutter-pi/blob/HEAD/raspberry:9999) in your browser

## Systemd

The ARM64 package includes a `run.sh` launcher. To install it as a system
service and start it immediately, run this on the Raspberry Pi from the
extracted package directory:

```sh
sudo ./run.sh install
```

This creates `plant-shutter.service`, enables it for future boots, and writes
the service output to `plant-shutter.log`. To run it only for the current
session, use `./run.sh` instead.

## Storage

```
.
└── root/
    ├── <project-name>/
    │   ├── images/
    │   │   ├── <image>.jpg
    │   │   ├── ...
    │   │   └── info.json
    ├── ...
    └── info.json
```

## Build

```sh
docker build --platform "linux/arm/v6" --output "./bin"  .
```

racheko-lab/blive-monitor.description: Bilibili/Douyin Live Stream Monitoring + WeChat Push Notifications
racheko-lab/blive-monitor.body:
# 📡 Bilibili/Douyin Live Stream Monitoring + Multi-Channel Push Notifications

A lightweight live stream status monitoring tool that supports Bilibili and Douyin platforms, automatically pushes notifications through multiple channels (Bark / Server Sauce / Enterprise WeChat / PushPlus / Telegram) when going live / new content.

## ✨ Features

- 🎬 **Multi-Platform Support**: Monitor Bilibili and Douyin live streams simultaneously
- 🔔 **Multi-Channel Push Notifications**: Send notifications through Bark / Server Sauce / Enterprise WeChat / PushPlus / Telegram when going live / new content
- 📊 **Live Stream Duration Statistics**: Record streaming duration and last broadcast time
- 📝 **Historical Logs**: Keep the last 200 status change records
- 🔄 **Merged Notifications**: Merge notifications into one when multiple broadcasters go live simultaneously
- 📱 **Responsive Page**: Mobile-friendly monitoring page
- 🎵 **New Content Detection**: Support detecting Douyin new content publication (optional)

## 📋 Quick Start

### 1. Configure Monitoring Rooms

Edit the `rooms.json` file to add broadcasters to monitor:

```json
[
  {
    "platform": "bilibili",
    "id": "1874913653",
    "name": "峰哥亡命天涯"
  },
  {
    "platform": "douyin",
    "id": "83134194400",
    "name": "27～"
  }
]
```

**Field Description:**
- `platform`: Platform, `bilibili` or `douyin`
- `id`: Live room ID
  - Bilibili: Room number (the number in the URL, such as `https://live.bilibili.com/1874913653`)
  - Douyin: Live room web_rid (the string in the URL, such as `https://live.douyin.com/83134194400`)
- `name`: Broadcaster name (used for display and push notifications)

### 2. Configure Push Channels (Optional)

Going live / new content notifications support multiple channels, configured via the `BLIVE_CONFIG` environment variable (JSON):

```bash
# Bark (iPhone, recommended)
export BLIVE_CONFIG='{"push": {"type": "bark", "url": "https://api.day.app/你的KEY", "group": "blive"}}'

# Or Enterprise WeChat group bot (free and unlimited, recommended)
export BLIVE_CONFIG='{"push": {"type": "wecom", "webhook": "https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/webhook/send?key=xxxx"}}'

# Or...
```

wlrwx/football-engine.description: Sports Lottery Football Probability Analysis System - Dixon-Coles + Monte Carlo Integrated Model, Fully Automated Running on GitHub Actions
wlrwx/football-engine.body:
# Sporttery Engine

Sports lottery football probability analysis and virtual betting simulation system. Based on Dixon-Coles Poisson model + Monte Carlo simulation, market probability-led fusion, Kelly criterion for virtual betting allocation, fully automated running on GitHub Actions, zero server costs. **For data analysis and algorithm learning only, does not constitute any betting advice, all outputs are virtual accounting.**

## Core Philosophy (2026-08 Data-Driven Evidence)

1. **Market as Benchmark**: 426-game ledger evidence, pure market (removed margin) Brier 0.583 outperforms any model flow (0.646+) → fusion weight market-led (0.75), model/third-party only fine-tuning
2. **All switches decided by data**: Every step of the fusion chain is a config switch (`config/prediction.json["fusion"]["post_fusion"]`), decided by `scripts/ablation_replay.py` paired replay against settled ledgers
3. **Self-Evolution with Guardrails**: Any automatic enablement of calibration layer/LGBM must pass time-series split + paired significance testing, automatic disable on degradation—see `docs/UPGRADE2_20260829.md` for details

## Architecture

```
Daily loop: fetch data → fused prediction (fusion.py, full trace) → lock → settlement → self-learning
Weekly loop: backtest → weight optimization (champion/challenger) → parameter refitting → weekly health check
Evolution loop: clean sample (chain=v2) accumulation → calibration layer auto enable/disable (calibration_auto)
                → LGBM shadow training+validation (lgbm_shadow) → weekly performance judgment (tracker)
```

## Tech Stack

- Python 3.12 / numpy / scikit-learn / LightGBM / joblib
- GitHub Actions (compute) + GitHub Pages (reports)
- No database, pure CSV/JSON + git versioning, ledger append-only

## Directory Structure

```
engine/
├── prediction/     # dixon_coles / monte_carlo / fusion (pure functions + switches + trace) / lgbm
├── strategy/       # kelly / odds level signal gate / popular area bet volume / edge capping / three-ticket system
├── learning/       # fusion_optimizer (weight auto-tuning) / calibration_auto (calibration self-evolution)
│                   # lgbm_shadow (shadow training) / league_params / elo
├──…
```

xiaolongbao0709/ai-virtual-phone-share.body:
# ai-virtual-phone-share · Resource Marketplace Repository

The resource repository for the Little Phone "Resource Marketplace" App. The marketplace page reads this repository via jsDelivr CDN, **folder structure is completely flexible** — whatever folder you create in the root directory, the marketplace homepage will display it.

## Contribution Format

**All resources should be placed uniformly in the `资源/` directory** (other folders in the root directory are service code, unrelated to resources).
One resource = **a subfolder** (recommended) or **an isolated file** under a category folder:

```
资源/
└── 预设/
    ├── 日常向预设/          ← subfolder-style resource (recommended)
    │   ├── 日常向.json       ← resource body (can be multiple)
    │   ├── 说明.txt          ← optional: description text (preview displayed in list)
    │   ├── 封面.jpg          ← optional: image (multiple allowed, first displayed in list)
    │   ├── .title            ← auto-generated: original title with stickers/formatting (folder name is sanitized version)
    │   ├── .author           ← auto-generated: contributor name (displayed on details page), optional
    │   ├── .avatar.png       ← auto-generated: contributor avatar (64×64), optional
    │   └── .owner            ← auto-generated: hash for contributor deletion/editing credentials, do not modify
    └── 极简预设.json        ← isolated file-style resource (plain text entry)
```

- Description file: `说明.txt` or `README.md` (inside subfolder)
- Images: `jpg / jpeg / png / webp / gif`, recommended ≤300KB per file
- Resource body: upload files exported from each feature page as-is (presets/regex/world book/character card JSON, character card PNG, CSS text, application zip, game/theater draft JSON, plugin JS)

## Index

`_index.json` is automatically rebuilt by GitHub Actions after each push (includes each resource's update time, description summary, and image list), **do not edit manually**.
`_flowers.json` is the flower count table ({resource path: flower count}), maintained by the upload service bot, also **do not edit manually**.

## Limits

- jsDelivr single file size limit: 20MB
- CDN caches `@main` (up to ~12 hours); to refresh immediately, visit
  `https://purge.jsdelivr.net/gh/xiaolongbao0709/ai-virtual-phone-share@main/_index.json`
